identitySignals: The agenda name 'Indigo Social Media Marketing' matches the business's own website, indigosocialmediamarketing.com, which uses that domain name and the brand 'Indigo Marketing'.
The company's About Us page says it is headquartered in Oakland, CA, which matches the agenda location. Third-party business directories also list it in Oakland.

The company is a marketing and media firm. It offers videography, photography and social media services and has a team of about 11. This fits a workplace-training partner for a career-exploration program (ECCCO).

review.notes: The site belongs to Indigo Social Media Marketing LLC, and its About Us page says it is headquartered in Oakland, CA, so the name and location match the agenda; the homepage confirms the services, phone number and email. The homepage now lists in-person meetings in Nashville and the SF Bay Area, and it names specific client industries instead of 'small and mid-sized businesses', but these are small wording gaps that don't cast doubt on the match.
